title: Save time with automatic status updates
description:
Jira Service Management now automatically updates agent availability status based on activity. This gives your team a real-time view of who is ready for work, improving routing accuracy without the manual effort. To get started with this change: In Jira Service Management, navigate to the Space settings of your space.
	Select Workforce, then Availabilty.
